description: Known differences between prisma/schema.prisma and the database built by prisma/migrations (B04-04). Each statement is what `prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script` prints today, i.e. what `prisma migrate dev` would generate. Never commit those statements as a migration. scripts/prisma-drift-check.mjs fails on any statement not listed here and on any listed statement that no longer appears.

notComparedByPrismaDiff.reason: Prisma 6 does not diff partial indexes, so these never appear in migrate diff output. src/lib/prisma-unmanaged-indexes.db.test.ts asserts their exact pg_get_indexdef after migrate deploy. Prisma 6 also does not diff CHECK constraints, triggers, functions, RLS, policies or grants.
